evidence_snippets: Request body The request body contains data with the following structure: JSON representation { "textQuery" : string , "languageCode" : string , "regionCode" : string , "rankPreference" : enum ( RankPreference ) , "includedType" : string , "openNow" : boolean , "minRating" : number , "maxResultCount" : integer , "pageSize" : integer , "pageToken" : string , "priceLevels" : [ enum ( PriceLevel ) ] , "strictTypeFiltering" : boolean , "locationBias" : { object ( LocationBias ) } , "locationRestriction" : { object ( LocationRestriction ) } , "evOptions" : { object ( EVOptions ) } , "routingParameters" : { object ( RoutingParameters ) } , "searchAlongRouteParameters" : { object ( SearchAlongRouteParameters ) } , "includePureServiceAreaBusinesses" : boolean , "includeFutureOpeningBusinesses" : boolean } Fields textQuery string Required.
When paginating, all parameters other than pageToken , pageSize , and maxResultCount provided to TextSearch must match the initial call that provided the page token.

The following table lists parameters in Text Search (Legacy) that have been renamed or modified for Text Search (New), or parameters that are no longer supported.
In contrast, with Text Search (Legacy), you pass URL parameters using an HTTP GET request.
